nodes.label: Windows Folder Picker
nodes.rationale: The webview's <input type=file> cannot reveal absolute paths (Chromium strips them) and Deno desktop has no native picker API yet, so a hidden PowerShell subprocess shells out to FolderBrowserDialog. Non-Windows returns null (path field only).

nodes.label: HTTP Server Entry & Window Setup
nodes.rationale: Static assets resolve from the real static/ folder in dev but from the embedded VFS relative to import.meta.url in a compiled binary; probe candidates at startup and pick the first containing index.html. Deno.BrowserWindow is exposed at runtime by deno desktop but not in the public type lib, so a structural cast mirrors the official denidian example; plain deno run (browser dev) skips the window.

nodes.label: Thumbnail Cache
nodes.rationale: vipsthumbnail renders a 512px WebP per file (3.5x the ~148px grid card width - sharp at HiDPI and future larger layouts), cached in the app-data dir keyed by path+size+thumb-size hash. FNV-1a 32-bit hash is stable with no crypto dependency; thumb size in the key invalidates stale caches when resolution changes. The webview lazy-loads via /thumb?path=... and the browser cache handles repeat views within a session.

nodes.label: Pure-Deno Header Parsing Pattern
nodes.rationale: Reading image dimensions from the header in pure Deno (image-header.ts) avoids subprocess spawns entirely: no console window flash, works in the compiled binary where subprocess exes may be virtual, and costs 0 subprocesses for output dims.

nodes.label: Settings Persistence
nodes.rationale: Missing/corrupt/out-of-schema JSON falls back to defaults; a partial object is tolerated and merged over the fallback. Writes are atomic via tmp file + rename.

nodes.label: vips Binary Resolution & VFS Materialization
nodes.rationale: In a compiled binary, --include'd files live in an embedded VFS that is virtual and not spawnable by Deno.Command; binaries are materialized to a real app-data location once, then spawned from there. In dev the project dir is used directly (no copy needed). import.meta-relative paths are NOT returnable - statSync succeeds on the VFS but the OS cannot spawn from it.

nodes.label: Embedded VFS Binary Materialization Pattern
nodes.rationale: Compiled binaries bundle --include'd files in a virtual filesystem that statSync succeeds on but the OS cannot spawn from; any spawnable binary must first be copied to a real app-data path. The same dev-vs-VFS duality drives static asset resolution in main.ts.
